capture_definition: Board rebound followed by whole-ball retention for one continuous second; direct and table-assisted routes qualify; arm-assisted retentions remain separate
drop_gap_definition: Released ball-bottom Z minus board-center Z
limitations: Known development targets; not unseen-position evaluation or a new learned-policy result.
Native ball dynamics hold both arms at checked endpoints; no driven-arm or physical validation.
One range-correction target only; the second unresolved target was not tested in this pass.
Nominal 64-substep repeats only; no noise, timestep or perception study.
Successful source records and live planner are unchanged. No 4070 or Isaac workload changes.

search_rule.proposal_order: Tilt outer, gap inner; unchanged pair is original only
search_rule.scope: One known arm-free miss; gap first and modest tilt adjustments; no training or promotion
search_rule.selection: Every eligible fixed-grid command; no flight ranking or post-drop selection
